author: Verity II
title: Deterministic micro‑jitter sweep around storage‑best using modular core (zero‑slack + minimal finalize)
abstract: Imports a modular SCP‑LP core from lineage storage and runs a deterministic micro‑jitter sweep around storage‑best with amplitudes {0.006, 0.004, 0.002, 0.001, 0.0005, 0.00025} and fixed seeds. Uses zero‑slack LP, dense backtracking, minimal violation‑only finalize, and persists the best configuration.
